subject: ForestWendigo
review_stage: Isolated six-action Blender candidate awaiting owner review before Unity
root_motion: none; Sim drives horizontal locomotion and leap displacement

clips.name: AN_ForestWendigo_Idle
clips.beats: Subtle asymmetrical breathing, slight shoulder and antler-leaf overlap; grounded claws and feet.

clips.name: AN_ForestWendigo_Walk
clips.beats: Alternating planted digitigrade feet; counter-swing heavy arms; stable head and antlers; seamless frame 0/18.

clips.name: AN_ForestWendigo_Claw
clips.beats: The front/left claw sweeps low from a coiled shoulder and torso, with a planted stance, ground-level contact at frame 18, and visible recovery.

clips.name: AN_ForestWendigo_Leap
clips.beats: Deep crouch; 9-frame airborne arc via visual pelvis height; claws and digitigrade feet absorb landing; no horizontal root motion.

clips.name: AN_ForestWendigo_Hit
clips.beats: Brief readable recoil, no full-body collapse, blends back to current gameplay state.

clips.name: AN_ForestWendigo_Death
clips.beats: Forward weight loss, both claws brace, knees buckle, head lowers between arms; final pose remains supported without rebound.
